specific_quotes: Sugar prices are expected to stay stable throughout the festive season (Oct 18, 2026, SOURCE 1, SOURCE 2)
analyses.summary: Sugar prices have remained stable over the last 3-6 months, with a slight increase to a 19-month high of 21.10 USD per pound in response to Brazil's election uncertainties and weak harvest figures. The situation is still tight due to lower-than-expected production, exports, and ethanol diversion, which have reduced the opening sugar inventory for the 2027 season to below 4 million tonnes, a decadal low. Despite a curb on sugar diversion for ethanol production, sugar prices are likely to remain firm due to low inventory levels and smaller production.
